d: Kachchi dargah-bidupur siks-len pul ka nam 'nitish setu' rakhe jane ko lekar chal rahi rajnitik charchaon ke bich bihar sarkar men mantri vijay kumar sinha ka bayan samne aaya hai. midiya se batchit karte hue mantri vijay kumar sinha ne is namakran ka samarthan kiya aur bina kisi ka nam lie virodh jatane valon par nishana sadha.
